name: ck-tools
description: Optional toolkit for Claude Code: utility skills for dependency upgrades, audits, snapshots and other repo-level chores, plus a band above the prompt with your 5-hour and weekly plan limits and pace. Designed to coexist with ck-code without overlapping its spec-driven workflow.

usage_band.title: Plan-limit band
usage_band.description: Show the 5-hour and weekly limits, your pace and the reset times above the prompt.

usage_alerts.title: Plan-limit toasts
usage_alerts.description: Toast once per window when its use crosses a threshold, and once when the pace runs it out before the reset.

usage_alert_at.title: Plan-limit toast thresholds
usage_alert_at.description: Comma-separated percentages that each toast once per window, such as 80,95.

update_check.title: Update check
update_check.description: Toast once and show a row above the prompt when the marketplace serves a newer version of this plugin.
